name: kg_query
description:
Run one read-only SQL SELECT against the live emi.db knowledge graph + supporting tables. Use this to investigate the KG the way a developer would: count things, follow provenance, find duplicates, compare nodes, walk windows back to source messages.

The statement MUST start with SELECT or WITH. PRAGMA table_info('<table>') and PRAGMA foreign_key_list('<table>') are also allowed for schema discovery. Anything else (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, ATTACH, etc.) is rejected. The connection is opened read-only at the SQLite level — writes are not possible.

Returns rows as both a markdown table (in `content`) and structured `data.rows`. Default cap is 200 rows; pass `max_rows` up to 5000 if needed. Long cells are truncated to 200 chars in the rendered table; full values stay in `data.rows`.

Schema cheatsheet:
- kg_node_metadata(id, label, node_type, category, aliases, description, original_sentence, start_date, end_date, importance, pagerank_score, window_id, source, created_at)
- kg_edge_metadata(id, source_id, target_id, relationship_type, sentence, window_id, source, created_at)
- kg_node_evidence(id, node_id, source_text, derived_sentence, message_timestamp, window_id, merge_action, created_at) — for source context, walk window_id -> kg_window_message -> unified_log_2026; per-claim source pointers are not stored
- kg_window(id, start_unified_log_id, end_unified_log_id, start_timestamp, end_timestamp, message_count, summary, standalone, related_previous_window_ids)
- kg_window_message(window_id, unified_log_id, item_order)
- kg_window_extraction(id, window_id, verdict, verdict_reason, nodes, edges, extractor_version, critic_version, created_at)
- kg_window_enrichment(id, window_extraction_id, component_index, enriched_nodes, enriched_edges, enricher_version, created_at)
- kg_resolved_message(id, unified_log_id, unified_timestamp, resolved_text)
- unified_log_2026(id, timestamp, role, speaker_name, message, room_id, source)
- claim_proposal(id, status, claim_type, confidence, representative_sentence, observation_count, first_observed_at, last_observed_at)
- claim_proposal_node(id, proposal_id, label, node_type, category, sentence, attributes_json, valid_from, valid_to, resolved_node_id, resolution_action)
- claim_proposal_edge(id, proposal_id, source_node_id, target_node_id, predicate, sentence)
- claim_proposal_evidence(id, proposal_id, window_id, enrichment_id, raw_text, observed_at)
- entity_cards(id, entity_name, source_node_id, summary, key_facts, aliases, updated_at)
- pod_store(pod_id, kind, tags_json, one_liner, body, source_refs_json, created_at)
- kg_maintenance_finding(id, finding_type, status, priority, primary_node_id, secondary_node_id, edge_id, reason, created_at)

KG pipeline stage flow (use these tables to answer 'what's pending in the pipeline'): unified_log_2026 -> kg_resolved_message -> kg_window+kg_window_message -> kg_window_extraction -> kg_window_enrichment -> claim_proposal* -> kg_node_metadata/kg_edge_metadata. A row is 'pending' if it exists in stage N but no downstream row references it from stage N+1.

Legacy / DEAD tables (do NOT query these for current pipeline state — they're left over from a January 2026 refactor): pipeline_batches, pipeline_chunks, pipeline_edges, kg_chat_conversation_window, kg_chat_conversation_window_item, kg_chat_extracted_node, kg_chat_extracted_edge, kg_chat_parsed_sentence, kg_chat_standardized_node, kg_chat_standardized_edge, kg_chat_enriched_node, kg_chat_merged_node_ref, kg_chat_merged_edge_ref, kg_chat_projection, kg_chat_projection_state, kg_chat_conversation_window_state.

inputs.name: sql
inputs.description: One SELECT (or WITH ... SELECT) statement. PRAGMA table_info()/foreign_key_list() also allowed for schema discovery. No semicolon-chained statements.

inputs.name: max_rows
inputs.description: Row cap (default 200, absolute max 5000). One extra row is fetched to detect truncation.

outputs.description: Summary line + markdown table of rows.
{columns: [string], rows: [object], row_count: int, truncated: bool, elapsed_ms: int}

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for kg_query:
- sql (required): one SELECT or WITH ... SELECT statement
- max_rows (optional): default 200, max 5000
